import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox
import googlemaps
from datetime import datetime

class TripPlanner:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = root
        self.api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
        self.gmaps = googlemaps.Client(key=self.api_key)
        self.create_widgets()

    def create_widgets(self):
        self.origin_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Origin")
        self.origin_label.pack()
        self.origin_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.origin_entry.pack()

        self.destination_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Destination")
        self.destination_label.pack()
        self.destination_entry = tk.Entry(self.root)
        self.destination_entry.pack()

        self.route_button = tk.Button(self.root, text="Get Route", command=self.get_route)
        self.route_button.pack()

        self.route_label = tk.Label(self.root, text="Route")
        self.route_label.pack()
        self.route_text = tk.Text(self.root)
        self.route_text.pack()

    def get_route(self):
        origin = self.origin_entry.get()
        destination = self.destination_entry.get()
        routes, traffic_conditions = self.get_routes(origin, destination)
        self.route_text.delete(1.0, tk.END)
        self.route_text.insert(tk.END, str(routes))

    def get_routes(self, origin, destination):
        now = datetime.now()
        traffic_conditions = self.get_traffic_conditions(origin, destination, now)
        routes = self.gmaps.directions(origin, destination, mode="driving", traffic_model="best_guess")
        return routes, traffic_conditions

    def get_traffic_conditions(self, origin, destination, now):
        traffic_conditions = self.gmaps.distance_matrix(origin, destination, mode="driving", departure_time=now)
        return traffic_conditions

# Usage
root = tk.Tk()
trip_planner = TripPlanner(root)
root.mainloop()
```
